title: root_seq admitted before downstream DIO acceptance: post-gate rejection burns the high-water mark
description: Review finding (b7z9.88.3 security pass, P3): verify_dio_root_signature mutates the seq cache (rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/receive.rs:734-744) and returns Verified, but the DIO is only then handed to process_authenticated_dio (receive.rs:530), which can still reject (e.g. RoleScopeMismatch). A receiver that verifies a genuine seq-N DIO but rejects it downstream will replay-reject (receive.rs:730-731) the root's genuine retransmission of seq N, cutting the node off from that DODAG state until the root increments to N+1. In-gate ordering (cross-check before cache mutation, receive.rs:717-723) is correct; the gap is across the gate boundary. Fix: defer root_seqs.accept until the DIO survives downstream processing, or roll back on downstream rejection. No forgery vector (requires genuine signed DIOs), self-healing. NOTE: currently dead in production because the clock is never wired (see wall-clock bead) — still worth fixing before clock wiring lands.
